en.marketHeading: What is actually different about marketing in {city}
market: I will be straight about this one: {city} is not an independent search market. Durham Region is the eastern end of the Greater Toronto Area, and when you advertise here you are bidding in auctions shaped by Toronto advertisers with Toronto budgets. That is the defining fact, and any page that told you otherwise would be selling you something.

What follows from it is genuinely useful. Because the cost per click is set by a market much larger than yours, precision is worth more in Durham than almost anywhere else. Targeting drawn around the communities you actually serve, a negative keyword list that removes downtown Toronto intent, and conversion tracking that counts a booked job are worth more to a {city} business than an increase in spend, because spending more just buys more of the same expensive clicks.

The upside is that Durham businesses win on radius. A tradesperson in {city} can serve Whitby, Ajax, Pickering, Courtice and Bowmanville without a Toronto commute, and a Toronto competitor bidding on the same keywords usually will not drive out here for the job. Making that service area explicit, in the targeting and on the site, is the most reliable advantage available to a Durham business.

faq.q: Do you have an office in {city}?
faq.a: No. I am based in Toronto and work from home, so there is no {city} office and I am not going to imply there is. Everything is run remotely over video and email, which is how I run every account.

Only if you will genuinely take the work and can compete on price with firms based there. For most Durham businesses the answer is no, and the more valuable move is excluding Toronto properly so your budget stops paying for clicks from people who will hire somebody closer to them.

faq.q: Why are our clicks as expensive as Toronto's?
faq.a: Because in most cases they are Toronto's. Loose geographic targeting and broad keywords pull you into the same auctions as advertisers with far larger budgets. That is fixable, it is normally the first thing I change, and it usually does more for the account than any budget increase would.

faq.q: Which service should a Durham business start with?
faq.a: SEO more often than not, because local results here are winnable in a way that paid clicks are not cheap. Ads come first when you need work booked immediately and the targeting has been tightened. AIO is cheap, one time, and few competitors have started.
Google Ads management is $1,500 a month plus your ad spend. SEO consulting is $1,200 a month. AIO consulting is $1,800 one time. No setup fees and no long contract.
